title: PV Sindhu flags gruelling Asian Games schedule after painful exit
indian_angle: India's top female shuttler, PV Sindhu, criticizes the demanding schedule after her Asian Games quarterfinal exit, highlighting player welfare concerns.
summary: PV Sindhu expressed her concerns about the demanding schedule at the Asian Games, where she played three singles matches within 18 hours, which she believes contributed to her quarterfinal exit.

title: Systemic flaws exposed in India's badminton campaign at Asian Games
indian_angle: This report critically examines the Indian badminton contingent's underwhelming performance at the Asian Games, pointing out systemic issues despite significant investment.
summary: An analysis of India's badminton campaign at the Asian Games reveals an underwhelming performance and missed opportunities, suggesting systemic flaws despite substantial investment in the sport.

title: Sindhu, Unnati, Treesa-Gayatri, Dhruv-Tanisha exit Asian Games quarters
indian_angle: India's individual badminton campaign at the Asian Games concluded with top players like PV Sindhu and young talent Unnati Hooda, along with doubles pairs, bowing out in the quarterfinals.
summary: India's individual badminton challenge at the Asian Games ended as PV Sindhu, Unnati Hooda, and the doubles pairs of Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand and Dhruv Kapila-Tanisha Crasto all lost their respective quarterfinal matches.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026 begins
indian_angle: The national coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's junior shuttlers for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, aiming to nurture future talent.
summary: A national coaching camp has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare Indian junior players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course signifies BAI's commitment to enhancing coaching standards across India, which is vital for player development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to upgrade coaching expertise.

title: New 3x15 scoring system implemented for domestic junior tournaments
indian_angle: The implementation of the 3x15 scoring system in domestic junior tournaments aims to align young Indian players with international standards and foster strategic play.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
